_doc: What the Windows gate queue checks for this candidate. Edited by the pilot for each candidate; read by the PC queue script. No machine paths here. From candidate 60 the gate judges what the player sees: the default traffic, which is the legacy one (MassTraffic runs only with -Traffic=mass). The 'blocking' criteria are read on the blocking passes; everything under 'informative_mass' is measured and reported on the MassTraffic passes but never fails the gate, and never stops it. Those criteria become blocking again only for switching the default traffic to mass, once a whole gate passes them (ADR-0015).

blocking.errors_scope: every blocking pass; Error lines of the MassTraffic passes are counted in informative_mass

_legacy_note: Legacy counts come from the line 'traffic cars t=...s:' every 10 s (default and gtarun passes). legacy_lying_max is read on its 'lying=' field. legacy_moving_upright_percent_120_300_min is judged on its share 'upright: P %' (the legacy traffic wants fewer cars than MassTraffic's 120, so a share, not a count), mean of 120 to 300 s; left empty on purpose: the pilot sets it from the measure of gate 59, not before. gtarun_crash_ok: step 12 (crash) of the gtarun pass must end ok on a 'legacy traffic car', so the player does not drive through the traffic. A missing count line or crash line on a blocking pass fails the gate.
